ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: BIM can automate drawings and quantity takeoffs, but technicians still decide whether site layout is accurate, how to handle deviations, and how to coordinate field work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 64,900 civil engineering technologists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 66,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,300 jobs, with about 5,500 annual job openings. The median annual salary is about $64,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace civil engineering technicians, but it will accelerate drafting and quantity takeoffs. BIM, automated takeoffs, and drone surveying speed up early work. Technicians shift from drawing and calculating toward site layout, quantity checks, coordination, and document review. Drafting is the task being accelerated. People who can work on site and verify quantities become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Site layout: people decide how to set the lines.
Deviation review: people decide how to correct issues.
Material inspection: people determine compliance.
Site coordination: people decide how to move work forward.
Document review: people verify accuracy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this career in the moderate exposure range for drafting work. Systems accelerate drawings and quantity takeoffs, while site work and coordination still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean job replacement. Drawing and quantity-takeoff tasks face automation, not the full role of layout, field verification, and coordination. Technicians with strong field and coordination skills become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to drafting face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a civil engineering or surveying associate degree. Practice CAD and BIM in school. Pure drafting work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop field and surveying skills early.
Move beyond drafting into field work and quantity verification. Learn BIM and drone surveying, then work toward an engineer or project manager role.
Highlight certifications and real project experience. State the types of projects you have worked on. Employers value reliability and field readiness.
Do not assess candidates only by software proficiency. Check their field accuracy. Strong coordinators can justify higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: BIM raises efficiency and reduces drafting work.
Infrastructure and renewal work remains steady.
Technicians who can coordinate field work are in greater demand.

body: Civil Engineering Technologists And Technicians assist engineers with drafting and quantity takeoffs, perform site layout and surveying, verify construction deviations and materials, organize technical records, and help civil projects follow plans and standards.
career_ai_description_block.heading: BIM can automate drawings and quantity takeoffs, but technicians still decide whether site layout is accurate, how to handle deviations, and how to coordinate field work.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: BIM 能自动出图和算量，但这地放得准不准、偏差怎么处理、现场怎么协调，还是技师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年土木工程技师与技术员在岗约 6.49 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.62 万人，净增约 0.13 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.42 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代土木技师，但会加速制图与算量。BIM、自动算量和无人机测量把前期提速，技师从「画图算」挪向「现场放样、核量、协调与资料把关」。真正被提速的是制图，能下现场会核量的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场放样：线怎么放靠人。
偏差核处：怎么改靠人。
材料检查：合不合规靠人。
现场协调：怎么推靠人。
资料把关：准不准靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的制图区——出图算量被系统加速，但现场与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于被替：被替代的是「画图、算量」的动作，不是「放样、核现场、协调」的岗位。有现场力和协调力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会画图的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 土木/测量大专打底，在校多摸 CAD 和 BIM。AI 时代纯制图在缩，早点练现场和测量。
从「画图」升级成「下现场 + 核量」，学 BIM 和无人机，争取转工程师或项目经理。
突出证书和真实项目经历，写清跟过哪些类型工程。雇主看重稳和能跑。
选人别只看软件熟，要看现场准不准。能协调的，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: BIM 提效，制图缩。
基建与更新稳。
会现场协调的更抢手。

body: 土木工程技师与技术员协助工程师进行制图与算量，开展现场放样与测量，核实施工偏差与材料，整理技术资料，保障土木项目按图按规落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: BIM 能自动出图和算量，但这地放得准不准、偏差怎么处理、现场怎么协调，还是技师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can handle data entry and logic checks, but people still decide whether to issue a query and how to resolve it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Clinical Data Managers is projected to rise from about 245,900 in 2024 to 328,300 in 2034, a net increase of about 82,400 jobs, with around 23,400 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $112,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Clinical Data Managers, but it will redesign the data-cleaning workflow. AI can automate entry, logic checks, coding, and query recommendations. Managers then shift from processing data to interpreting protocols, resolving queries, and making compliance judgments. The scarce professionals are those who can set standards between rules and evidence and remain accountable for the data.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent prediction of missing and anomalous data
ai_s2_auto: Automating data entry and double entry
ai_s3_list: Protocol interpretation: people must read the protocol to define the standards.
Query resolution: people decide whether a query should be issued.
Compliance judgment: people safeguard regulatory acceptability.
Cross-functional coordination: people connect medical teams and Sites.
Final accountability: people answer for data problems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure tier. Data entry and checks are heavily automated, while query resolution and compliance still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces data entry and routine checks, not the career itself. Managers who can build databases, resolve queries, and understand compliance become more valuable. People who only enter data without reading protocols face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in pharmacy and statistics, then practice GCP and database skills while in school. In the AI era, query resolution and compliance create value. Do not limit yourself to data entry.
Advance from cleaning data to database design and query resolution. Study protocols and standards, and pursue a Lead DM role instead of remaining in routine checks.
Highlight database and query-management experience, and specify the therapeutic areas you have managed. Oncology and international-registration projects provide an advantage.

Hire for protocol understanding and compliance judgment, not just data-entry experience. Clinical Data Managers who can resolve queries independently and accept accountability justify higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: As data entry and checks become automated, managers shift toward query resolution.
Innovative-drug development and international trials sustain long-term hiring.
Multidisciplinary DMs who can build databases and understand compliance are in greater demand.

body: Clinical Data Managers plan data-collection and quality standards for clinical trials. They design databases and electronic case report forms, then manage data entry, cleaning, coding, and queries to keep trial data complete and accurate.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can handle data entry and logic checks, but people still decide whether to issue a query and how to resolve it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 录入和逻辑核查能交给系统，但「这条质疑该不该发、怎么裁」，还得人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年临床数据经理在岗约 24.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.83 万人，净增约 8.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代临床数据管理员，但会重做清理流程。自动录入、逻辑核查、编码和质疑推荐交给 AI 后，管理员从「跑数」挪向「方案理解、质疑裁决与合规判断」。真正稀缺的是能在规则和证据间定口径、为数据担责的人。
ai_s2_accel: 缺失与异常的智能预测
跨库一致性的自动比对
质疑优先级的智能排序
ai_s2_auto: 数据录入与双录的自动化
逻辑核查规则的自动运行
质疑的自动生成与归类
ai_s3_list: 方案理解：口径靠人读协议。
质疑裁决：发不发靠人定。
合规判断：可接受性靠人守。
跨方协调：医学 Site 串起来。
责任兜底：数据出问题要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的数据区——录入与核查大量被自动化，但裁决与合规还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录入和跑核查」，不是「岗位」。会建库、能裁决、懂合规的管理员反而更稀缺。怕的是只做机械录数、不读方案的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 药学统计打底，在校把 GCP 和数据库练了。AI 时代拼的是裁决和合规，别只做录数。
从「清理」升级成「建库 + 裁决」，学方案和标准，争取转 Lead DM，别停留在机械核查。
突出数据库与质疑经验，写清管过哪些治疗领域。有肿瘤和出海项目优先。
招人看方案理解和合规，不止看录数。能独立裁决、敢担责的管理员值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 录入与核查不断自动化，管理员转向裁决。
创新药与出海试验长期用人。
会建库懂合规的复合 DM 更抢手。

body: 临床数据管理员规划临床试验的数据收集与质量标准，设计数据库与电子病例报告表，管理数据录入、清理、编码与质疑，确保临床试验数据完整、准确。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 录入和逻辑核查能交给系统，但「这条质疑该不该发、怎么裁」，还得人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An online particle-size analyzer can adjust automatically, but operators still decide settings for material changes, evaluate abnormalities, and protect safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 28,700 Crushing, Grinding, And Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 27,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 800 jobs, with roughly 2,700 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $46,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace the occupation as a whole, but automation will keep absorbing standardized control. Automatic feeding and online particle-size analysis accelerate routine adjustments, shifting operators from watching gauges and turning valves toward parameter changes, troubleshooting, equipment care, and safety control. People who only follow standard gauges face pressure, while operators who adjust settings and maintain equipment become more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Parameter adjustment during material changes: people rely on practical feel.
Abnormality assessment: people rely on experience.
Equipment care: people judge operating condition.
Safety control: people remain alert.
Process coordination: people work together.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation at low-moderate AI exposure in a highly automated manufacturing setting. Systems absorb standardized control, while parameter adjustment and equipment care still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Watching standard gauges and turning valves are being replaced, not the role of adjusting settings during material changes and maintaining safety. Operators who tune parameters and care for equipment become scarcer as automation expands. People who watch only one gauge face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in vocational school and practice parameter adjustment and inspections. Gauge-watching work is shrinking, so learn equipment early.
Move beyond watching gauges into parameter adjustment and inspections. Learn the process and work toward responsibility for a machine line.
Highlight proficiency and yield, and specify the materials you have handled. Factories value steadiness and safety.
Do not select candidates on physical strength alone. Evaluate their ability to care for equipment. Experienced workers who protect safety merit higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Centralized control becomes widespread, reducing standardized adjustment work.
Material-change settings and equipment care create opportunities.
Operators who protect safety are in greater demand.

body: Crushing, Grinding, And Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders set up and operate crushing, grinding, and polishing equipment. They control feed, speed, and classification, monitor particle size and equipment condition, and support material changes and inspections.
career_ai_description_block.heading: An online particle-size analyzer can adjust automatically, but operators still decide settings for material changes, evaluate abnormalities, and protect safety.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 在线粒度仪自动调，但换料怎么设、异常怎么判、安全怎么守，还是操作工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 2.87 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.79 万人，岗位净减约 0.08 万个，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.69 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会整体取代，但自动化会持续吃标准调控。自动给料与在线粒度仪把常规调控提速，操作工从「盯表调阀」挪向「换料调参、异常处理、设备看护、安全守门」。真正被挤掉的是只盯标准表的人，会调参会看护的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 换料调参：手感靠人。
异常判断：经验靠人。
设备看护：状态靠人。
安全守门：警觉靠人。
工艺协调：配合靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光但高自动化的制造区——标准调控被系统吃，但调参与看护还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「盯标准表调阀」动作，不是「换料调参 + 安全看护」的岗位。会调参会看护的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会看一个表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校起步多练调参和巡检，纯盯表在缩，早点学设备。
从「盯表」升级成「会调参 + 懂巡检」，学工艺，争取机台负责。
突出熟练和良率，写清跟过哪些物料。工厂看重稳和安全。
选人别只看力气，要看会不会看护。能守安全的骨干，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 集中控制普及，标准调控缩。
换料调参与看护带来机会。
会守安全的操作工更抢手。

body: 破碎、研磨与抛光机调试操作工设置并操作粉碎、研磨与抛光设备，调控给料、转速与分级，监测粒度与设备状态，并配合换料与巡检。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 在线粒度仪自动调，但换料怎么设、异常怎么判、安全怎么守，还是操作工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI and 3D printing can produce dozens of crown models overnight, but technicians still adjust shade, bite, and fit one detail at a time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 35,200 Dental Laboratory Technicians were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 33,600 by 2034. That represents about 1,600 fewer jobs, with roughly 3,900 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $48,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dental Laboratory Technicians, but it will redefine their technical work. Intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM design, and 3D printing accelerate modeling. Technicians now spend more time on digital design, automated equipment, and final quality control. The scarce skill is turning machine-made blanks into restorations that fit, look natural, and align correctly.
ai_s2_accel: Automated design of implant guides and complex restorations
AI image assistance for quality inspection
ai_s2_auto: Intraoral scanning replaces casting from traditional impressions.
CAD standardizes crown and bridge shapes.
3D printing forms resin and metal bases directly.
Automated scheduling and production data management
ai_s3_list: Shade and texture judgment: experience determines ceramic layering and the final fired color.
Occlusal adjustment: technicians manually correct differences between machine output and a patient's actual bite.
Marginal integrity and fit: millimeter-level finishing determines whether a restoration remains secure.
Materials and process experience: different ceramics and furnaces require practiced control of firing conditions.
Communication with dentists: technicians use professional judgment to identify and resolve missing model information.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Dental Laboratory Technicians in the moderate AI exposure range. AI accelerates design and modeling, while people still perform manual finishing and quality judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean unemployment. Digital systems replace repetitive production, while inspection and adjustment from blank to finished restoration gain value. Traditional-only technicians face pressure. Technicians who use CAD/CAM and 3D printing become more sought after.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Dental technology remains a worthwhile field, but prioritize digital skills. Learn CAD/CAM, intraoral scanning, and 3D printing. Technicians who combine digital fluency with strong finishing skills are the hardest to replace.
Learn CAD/CAM and automated equipment quickly. Reserve hands-on time for final inspection and complex restorations. Implant restorations and precision attachments command much higher piece rates.

Enter through a dental laboratory apprenticeship or digital design role and learn the full denture production process. Employers prefer people who operate 3D printers and design software while also learning manual finishing.
Do not assess technicians on manual dexterity alone. Evaluate digital design and automated equipment skills. Technicians who verify machine output and handle complex cases merit higher compensation.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Replaces traditional impressions and captures data immediately
Precision milling of zirconia and resin
Fabrication of models, guides, and temporary crowns
Digital shade measurement and color-difference analysis
Marginal fit and dimensional accuracy measurement

ai_s7_trends: Intraoral scanning and digital workflows become standard, reducing traditional casting work.
AI design and 3D printing increase capacity, shifting technicians toward quality control and complex cases.
Demand grows for implant and digital aesthetic restorations, increasing the premium for advanced technicians.

body: Dental Laboratory Technicians use dentist-provided impressions or scan data to make dentures, crowns, bridges, veneers, and orthodontic appliances. Their work includes casting, design, ceramic layering, sintering, grinding, and polishing.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI and 3D printing can produce dozens of crown models overnight, but technicians still adjust shade, bite, and fit one detail at a time.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 和 3D 打印能一夜之间出几十颗牙冠的模型，但「这颗牙的颜色像不像邻牙、咬合顺不顺」，还得技工一处处调。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年牙科实验室技术员在岗约 3.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.36 万人，岗位净减约 0.16 万个，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代牙科实验室技术员，但会重定义这个岗位的技术构成。口内扫描、CAD/CAM 设计、3D 打印让「建模」环节越来越快，技术员的时间从手工倒模挪向数字化设计、自动设备操作和最终质检。真正稀缺的，是把机器做出来的毛坯调到「能戴、好看、咬合对」的收尾手艺。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的牙冠形态自动设计
颜色匹配与比色的智能化
种植导板与复杂修复体的自动化设计
质检环节的 AI 影像辅助检查
ai_s2_auto: 传统取模的倒模环节被口内扫描替代
CAD 设计标准化牙冠与牙桥外形
3D 打印直接成型树脂与金属基底
自动化排产与生产数据管理
ai_s3_list: 颜色与质感判断：瓷层堆到第几层、烧出来什么色，是长期练出来的眼力。
咬合调整：机器出的形态和人的真实咬合之间，差的全是手工微调。
边缘密合与贴合适配：戴不戴得稳，靠的是毫米级的收尾功夫。
材料与工艺经验：不同瓷粉、不同烤瓷炉，火候差别靠经验拿捏。
与牙医的沟通：模型信息不全时，怎么补、怎么问，考验专业判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业正处在技术转型的交叉点：设计建模环节被 AI 加速，同时手工修整环节仍然依赖人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中风险不等于失业：数字化替代的是重复性生产环节，而「从毛坯到成品」的质检与调整价值更高。只会传统手工的技工面临压力，掌握 CAD/CAM 和 3D 打印的技师反而更抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 口腔医学技术专业依然值得，但一定要把数字化方向放前面：CAD/CAM、口扫、3D 打印都要会。纯手工技工的路正在变窄，会数字化又能守住手艺的人最稀缺。
尽快补齐 CAD/CAM 和自动化设备操作，把手艺时间用在最终质检和复杂修复体上。往种植修复、精密附件等高端方向走，计件单价完全不同。
从技工所学徒或数字化设计岗切入，先熟悉义齿生产流程。会操作 3D 打印和设计软件、又愿意学手工收尾的人，比只会单一环节的更受欢迎。
招技工别只看手工熟练度，要看会不会数字化设计和自动设备操作。能给机器做质检兜底、能处理复杂病例的技师，值得给更高待遇。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 替代传统取模、数据即得
边缘密合、尺寸精度测量

ai_s7_trends: 口扫与数字化流程成为标配，传统倒模环节持续收缩。
AI 设计与 3D 打印把产能抬高，技术员向「质检 + 复杂病例」集中。
种植修复与数字化美学修复需求上升，高端技师的溢价继续扩大。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Online monitors can report data automatically for 24 hours, but technicians still go on site to determine why a reading suddenly exceeds limits and whether the sampling location is valid.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 12,900 Environmental engineering technologists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 13,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs, with about 1,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $58,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental engineering technologists and technicians, but it will restructure the field. Online monitoring, automated sampling, and intelligent reports are replacing many routine laboratory and data-entry roles. Pure laboratory positions will decline. Technicians who maintain equipment, collect samples on site, and investigate abnormal data remain essential. Smarter monitoring systems still need people to place sensors, calibrate instruments, trace causes, and respond.
ai_s2_accel: Operate automated online stations for water quality and flue gas
Use AI to flag and trace abnormal data
Use drones for sampling and inspection
ai_s2_auto: Digitize sample registration and data entry
ai_s3_list: Sampling standards: get location, frequency, and preservation right every time.
Equipment maintenance: calibrate, service, and troubleshoot online instruments.
Anomaly tracing: locate pollution sources when readings exceed limits.
Field judgment: assess sampling conditions and operating status together.
Quality control: keep data traceable and reproducible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Samples, data, and reports follow standardized workflows that online monitoring and AI analysis can automate. The score is 7 rather than 9 because equipment maintenance, field sampling, and anomaly response still depend on technician experience and fieldwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Do not compete with machines on routine laboratory work. Move toward equipment maintenance, data tracing, and field incident response. Upgrade from operating instruments to managing a complete monitoring system. As monitoring becomes more automated, maintenance and judgment skills become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study environmental monitoring or environmental engineering and build strong laboratory and instrumentation skills. This work includes field sites, stacks, and riverbanks, so prepare for physical demands. Earn relevant operating and laboratory credentials because certificates often determine entry eligibility.

Do not stop at laboratory testing. Learn online monitoring equipment maintenance and data analysis, then move toward quality control, source tracing, or project supervision. AI replaces routine tests, not people who manage monitoring systems.
People with chemistry, biology, or testing backgrounds can transfer readily. In interviews, highlight certifications, instruments operated, sample types handled, and data-control standards.

Technician turnover can be high. Retention improves with certification allowances, project incentives, and a path toward engineering roles. Developing experienced technicians into equipment-maintenance and quality-control leads costs less than continual replacement hiring.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Measure COD, ammonia nitrogen, and total phosphorus
Analyze particulate matter and exhaust gases

ai_s6_tools.工具: Sampler for water, air, and soil

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Manage samples and data through the full workflow
Rapidly test heavy metals and turbidity

ai_s7_trends: Expanding online monitoring networks continue to reduce routine laboratory roles.
Equipment maintenance and data tracing become core technician skills.
Tighter environmental regulation increases demand for certified field technicians.

body: Environmental engineering technologists and technicians work under engineers on environmental monitoring and project support. They collect samples, analyze water quality, maintain equipment, organize data, and assist with pollution-control projects on site.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Online monitors can report data automatically for 24 hours, but technicians still go on site to determine why a reading suddenly exceeds limits and whether the sampling location is valid.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 在线监测仪能 24 小时自动报数，但「这个数据为什么突然超标、采样点位对不对」——还得技师去现场查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年环境工程技师与技术员在岗约 1.29 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.30 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.89 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代环境工程技师，但会重新洗牌：在线监测、自动采样、智能报表正在取代大量常规化验和数据录入岗位，纯「化验员」会越来越少。留下的是会运维设备、能现场采样、能处理异常数据的技师——监测系统越智能，越需要人去布点、校准、溯源和处置。
ai_s2_accel: 在线水质/烟气自动监测站
AI 异常数据预警与溯源
无人机辅助采样与巡查
ai_s2_auto: 样品登记与数据录入电子化
常规化验指标自动化检测
在线监测数据自动采集
ai_s3_list: 采样规范：点位、频次、保存一步不差。
设备运维：在线仪器校准、维护、故障处理。
异常溯源：数据超标时查出污染来源。
现场判断：采样环境与工况的综合评估。
质控意识：数据可追溯、可复现。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个岗位的「流程面」高度自动化友好：样品、数据、报表都是标准化流程，在线监测和 AI 分析正在大规模接手；但 7 分不是 9 分——设备运维、现场采样、异常处置仍需要技师的经验和脚力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 别跟机器抢「化验」的活：往设备运维、数据溯源、现场应急处置方向走，把「会操作仪器」升级成「能管一套监测系统」；监测越自动，会维护和会判断的人越稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选环境监测或环境工程专业，把化验和仪器课程学扎实；提醒孩子这行要跑现场、爬烟囱、踩河滩，做好吃苦准备；多考证（上岗证、化验证），证书是入行的敲门砖。
别停留在「会化验」：学在线监测设备运维和数据分析，往质控、溯源、项目主管方向走；AI 抢的是化验的活，抢不了「会管监测系统」的人。
有化学、生物、检测背景的人转过来很顺；面试时突出持证情况和操作过的仪器设备，讲清你做的样品类型和数据规范。
技师流失快，留人靠「持证补贴+项目分成+晋升到工程师的通道」；把有经验的技师培养成设备运维和质控骨干，比不断招新人划算。

ai_s7_trends: 在线监测网络扩大，常规化验岗位持续收缩。
设备运维与数据溯源成为技师的核心竞争力。
环保监管趋严，持证现场型技师需求上升。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can schedule production and collect work reports, but supervisors still lead people, resolve disruptions, and stabilize the line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 698,600 production worker supervisors employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 706,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 8,300 jobs, with about 67,700 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $71,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace production supervisors, but it will reduce junior oversight. MES automates production scheduling, reporting, and inspections. Supervisors shift from monitoring forms toward leading people, resolving disruptions, and stabilizing the production rhythm. Roles limited to data entry face pressure. Leaders who can guide teams and recover operations become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Team motivation: people sustain morale.
Exception judgment: people make tradeoffs.
On-site coordination: people direct resources.
Quality control: people apply experience.
Safety supervision: people monitor people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate production scheduling and inspections, while people remain central to leadership and exception handling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces form filling and number tracking, not the role of leading people and recovering operations. Supervisors who guide teams and stabilize production become scarcer as productivity rises. Roles limited to copying readings face greater pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build on-site experience through mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing work. Pure supervision is shrinking in the AI era, so develop leadership skills early.
Advance from monitoring forms to leading people and resolving disruptions. Learn MES and data skills.
Highlight production-line leadership. State how many people and machines you managed.
Do not assess candidates only by tenure. Look for leadership ability. Strong employees who stabilize production merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: MES adoption reduces junior roles.
Exception alerts become automated.
Experienced employees who lead people become more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排产报工有系统接，但带人、调异常、稳节奏，还是主管定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管生产工人在岗约 69.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 70.69 万人，净增约 0.83 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.77 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生产主管，但会压缩初级监督。MES 把排产、报工、巡检自动化，主管从「盯表」挪向「带人、调异常、稳节奏」。真正被挤掉的是只填表的，能带人能救火的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 带人激励：士气靠人。
异常判断：取舍靠人。
现场协调：调度靠人。
质量把关：经验靠人。
安全监督：人盯人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——排产巡检被系统加速，但带人与调异常还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「填表盯数」动作，不是「带人救火」的岗位。能带人、能稳节奏的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会抄表。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电/制造起步多练现场，AI 时代纯监督在缩，早点练带人。
从「盯表」升级成「带人 + 调异常」，学 MES 与数据。
突出带线经验，写清管过多少人和机台。
选人别只看资历，要看能不能带人。能稳节奏的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: MES 普及，初级岗缩。
异常预警自动化。
能带人的骨干更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage leads, quotes, and time records, but steady sanding and even finishes still depend on skilled hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 5,600 Floor Sanders And Finishers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 5,800 by 2034, a net gain of about 200 jobs, with about 400 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $49,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Floor Sanders And Finishers, but it will change how they find and manage work. Systems can handle bookings, job assignments, quotes, quantities, and dust-control records. Workers shift from searching for jobs to winning platform work through their craft. Machine operation, repairs, finish application, and rework decisions remain hands-on. AI manages the job, but people determine whether the floor is level and the finish is even.
ai_s2_accel: New automated sanding equipment raises productivity
Dustless sanding and extraction systems become widespread
Water-based finishes and environmentally safer methods expand
Online work platforms become a primary source of jobs
ai_s2_auto: Booking, job assignment, and quote management
ai_s3_list: Sander control: travel speed and pressure directly determine floor flatness.
Repair craft: fill cracks, dents, and raised edges without visible traces.
Finish control: coating amount, number of coats, and sanding intervals affect bubbles and uniformity.
Site judgment: assess floor material, damage, and renovation value before work begins.
Service and reputation: deliver a finished floor that looks right in the customer's home.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Workflow and management tasks such as dispatch, quoting, and recordkeeping are being automated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Better equipment raises expectations for process knowledge and repair skills. Finish application and repairs become more valuable, while low-end sanding based only on physical effort faces pressure. Workers who repair damage and understand finishes remain in demand.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This trade is a practical technical option with low formal education requirements. Learn a combined renovation skill set covering sanding + installation + repair. Younger craftspeople are valued in the renovation market.

Learn dustless sanding and environmentally safer finish methods, then pursue higher-end renovation work. Advancing from sander operator to flooring refinishing specialist can more than double project rates.

People with renovation or woodworking backgrounds can transition quickly. Start as a sanding helper, learn the full repair and finishing process, then take independent jobs or work with a renovation contractor.
Do not hire sanders on physical strength alone. Evaluate process details and finished quality. Workers with repair skills, finish knowledge, and strong customer reviews justify higher rates.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Coarse sanding, fine sanding, and polishing
Dust extraction, dust reduction, and cleaner work
Roller, brush, and even finish application
Detailed sanding along walls and in corners

ai_s7_trends: Dustless sanding and environmentally safer finishes are becoming standard. Equipment replaces low-end physical sanding, raising the value of process skill and customer reputation.
Renovation of existing and previously owned homes continues to grow. Demand remains stable for floor refinishing specialists who repair damage and understand finishes.
Platform-based lead generation is mature. Highly rated craftspeople command clear premiums, and independent contracting is becoming common.

body: Floor Sanders And Finishers sand, repair, and coat wood floors. They clear sites, perform coarse and fine sanding, remove dust, apply finishes, and polish surfaces. The role combines physical work with technical craft in renovation and remodeling.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can manage leads, quotes, and time records, but steady sanding and even finishes still depend on skilled hands.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你接单、报价、记工时，但打磨机推得稳不稳、漆上得匀不匀，靠的还是那双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年地板打磨工修整工在岗约 0.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.58 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.04 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代地板打磨工，但会改变接单和管理方式。预约派单、报价清单、工程量记录、除尘数据都被 AI 接手，打磨工从「四处找活」转向「平台接单 + 手艺赚钱」。真正不可替代的是打磨机的现场操作、修补与漆面处理的手艺、以及返工判断——AI 能帮你管活，但地板磨得平不平、漆上得好不好，机器替不了手。
ai_s2_accel: 新型自动打磨设备提高效率
无尘打磨与除尘系统普及
水性漆与环保工艺推广
线上平台接单成为主流
ai_s2_auto: 预约派单与报价清单管理
ai_s3_list: 打磨机操作手感：推得快慢、压力大小，直接决定地板平整度。
修补工艺：裂缝、凹陷、翘边，补得看不出痕迹靠手艺。
漆面控制：漆量、遍数、打磨间隔，起泡不均都要返工。
现场判断：地板材质、受损程度、翻新价值，进场先看明白。
服务与口碑：客户家的地面，交到手里要交得漂亮。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的流程与管理工作正被自动化——派单、报价、记录都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为设备在提效，打磨工被要求「更懂工艺、更会修补」，漆面处理和修补手艺反而更值钱。真正被挤压的是纯体力低端打磨，会修补、懂漆面的师傅在翻新市场依然抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 适合作为技术工种储备，不要求高学历。建议学装修相关技能组合（打磨+铺装+修补），年轻师傅在翻新市场吃香。
把无尘打磨、环保漆工艺学起来，主动接高端翻新单。从「打磨工」升级为「地板翻新师傅」，工价能翻一倍以上。
有装修、木工背景的转行者上手快。先从打磨小工做起，掌握修补上漆全流程，再独立接单或挂靠装修公司。
招打磨工别只看体力，要看工艺细节和成品质量。会修补、懂漆面、客户评价好的师傅，值得给更高工价。

ai_s7_trends: 无尘打磨与环保漆成为标配，低端体力打磨被设备替代，工艺手艺与客户口碑价值上升。
二手房与旧房翻新市场持续增长，会修补、懂漆面的地板翻新师傅需求稳定。
平台化接单成熟，手艺好、评价高的师傅溢价明显，独立接单成为主流模式。

body: 地板打磨工修整工负责木地板的打磨、修补与表面涂装，执行清场、粗磨细磨、除尘、上漆与抛光等工序，恢复或更新地板表面，是装修与翻新行业中技术导向的体力手艺岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify a tree with yellowing leaves, but a groundskeeper still chooses the exact angle of the cut when shaping it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,192,500 workers employed in 2024, projected to reach 1,235,000 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 42,500 jobs, with roughly 158,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $38,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace landscaping and groundskeeping workers, but it will change how they maintain landscapes. Smart irrigation, plant-identification apps, and robotic mowers now support decisions once made entirely through experience and observation. Yet shaping plants, planting, and treating pests and diseases remain hands-on work. Machines can cut evenly, but they cannot decide what form a particular shrub should take.
ai_s2_accel: AI pest and disease detection: identify plant disease from leaf images
Drone landscape inspections: monitor large green areas
Smart hedge trimmers: automatically position and trim
Maintenance data platforms: digitize irrigation and fertilization records
ai_s2_auto: Smart irrigation systems: water automatically based on soil moisture
Robotic lawn mowers: mow automatically within defined areas
Maintenance scheduling software: automatically schedule tasks, workers, and zones
Plant-identification apps: identify species and care guidance from photos
ai_s3_list: A feel for shaping: people still finish areas that machines cannot cut cleanly and choose the right angle and height.
Plant-condition judgment: experience and observation distinguish water stress from nutrient deficiency.
Planting and transplanting technique: root pruning and soil preparation determine whether plants survive.
On-site safety and responsibility: people make safety judgments while trimming high branches and operating equipment.
Communication with clients and residents: people coordinate trimming plans and resolve disruption concerns.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score means about half the work involves standardized trimming and irrigation. Smart equipment increasingly assists with those tasks, but AI can only help observe plant condition and shaping needs; it cannot perform the core hands-on judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Smart equipment diverts repetitive physical tasks, while workers who understand plant care, shape plants skillfully, and operate new equipment become more competitive. Basic roles limited to pushing a mower face pressure, while technical maintenance workers gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Formal education requirements are modest. Vocational study in landscaping, horticulture, or landscape construction combined with practice is a strong route. Focus on plant care and pruning, and earn a landscaping credential. Workers who understand maintenance and smart equipment are more valuable in the AI era.

Do not stop at operating a mower. Add plant care, shaping, and pest-management skills, earn a horticulture credential, and move from physical grounds work to technical maintenance. Smart-equipment operation is another advantage.

Start with a landscaping company or property manager and learn basic pruning and maintenance. Quantify the area maintained, landscape zones covered, and plant-survival rates on your resume; those results matter more than generic claims of hard work.

Hire for maintenance skill and responsibility, not merely willingness to do physical work. People who understand plants, can shape them, and operate new equipment merit higher pay. Purely physical workers are harder to recruit, while technical workers are even scarcer.

ai_s7_trends: Urbanization continues to expand green space, supporting stable long-term maintenance demand. Property managers and municipal agencies are the main employers.
Smart irrigation, robotic mowers, and other automated equipment divert basic repetitive work, shifting the occupation toward technical maintenance.
The role is evolving into a technical gardener who understands plant care and equipment. Versatile workers who can manage a small landscape area are increasingly valuable.

body: Landscaping and groundskeeping workers plant, trim, and routinely maintain lawns, shrubs, flower beds, and trees. They manage irrigation, fertilization, pest control, and site cleanup, forming a large foundational workforce in landscaping and urban management.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能识别出哪棵树的叶子黄了，但修剪造型时那一剪刀的角度，还得绿化工自己把握。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 119.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 123.50 万人，净增约 4.25 万个岗位，年均产生约 15.82 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代绿化和场地养护工人，但会改变「养护方式」。以前靠经验和眼睛判断什么时候浇、怎么修，现在有智能浇灌系统、植物识别 App、智能割草机器人辅助。可修剪造型、种植、病虫害处理这些现场活，还得靠人——机器能剪平，但不替你判断这棵灌木该剪成什么形状。
ai_s2_accel: AI 病虫害识别：叶片图像自动判断病害
无人机绿化巡检：大面积绿地状态监测
智能绿篱修剪机：自动定位与修剪
养护数据平台：浇灌、施肥记录数字化
ai_s2_auto: 智能浇灌系统：按土壤湿度自动浇水
智能割草机器人：设定区域自动修剪草坪
养护排班软件：任务、人员、区域自动排程
植物识别 App：拍照识别品种与养护要点
ai_s3_list: 修剪造型的手感：什么角度、什么高度，机器剪不平的地方，还得人收边。
植物状态判断：叶子黄了是缺水还是缺肥，靠经验和观察。
种植与移栽的技术：根怎么修、土怎么培，是植物成活的关键。
现场的安全与责任：修剪高空枝条、操作设备，安全判断靠人。
与客户和居民的沟通：修剪方案、扰民处理，需要人来协调。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在标准化的修剪和浇灌上——这些正被智能设备辅助，但植物状态判断、造型修剪这些核心，AI 只能帮忙看，不能替人动手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。智能设备分流的是「重复性纯体力活」，懂植物养护、会造型修剪、能操作新设备的工人反而更有竞争力。真正被挤压的是「只会推割草机」的纯基础岗，技术型养护工人价值在上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，职校的园林园艺、绿化工程类专业加实践是好路线。重点学植物养护和修剪技术，考园林绿化工证书。AI 时代，懂养护、会用智能设备的工人更吃香。
别只会推割草机。把植物养护、造型修剪、病虫害防治补起来，考个园艺证书，从「体力养护工」升级为「技术养护工」。智能设备操作也学起来，那是加分项。
从绿化公司或物业做起，先学基础修剪和养护。简历上写「负责面积、养护区域、植物成活率」这类可量化成果，比空喊吃苦耐劳有用。
招人别只看「能不能干活」，要看养护技术和责任心。懂植物、会造型修剪、能操作新设备的工人，值得给更高薪酬——纯体力工越来越不好招，技术型工人更难找。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 土壤湿度感应、定时浇水
拍照识别、养护要点查询

ai_s7_trends: 城市化让绿地面积只增不减，绿化养护需求长期稳定，物业和市政是主要雇主。
智能浇灌、割草机器人等自动化设备分流基础重复活，养护工作重心转向技术养护。
绿化工角色升级为「懂养护、会设备的技术型园丁」，能管理小片绿地的复合型人才更吃香。

body: 绿化和场地养护工人负责草坪、灌木、花坛、树木的种植、修剪与日常养护，管理绿地的浇灌、施肥、病虫害防治和场地清理，是园林绿化与城市管理体系中数量庞大的基础岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能识别出哪棵树的叶子黄了，但修剪造型时那一剪刀的角度，还得绿化工自己把握。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can research statutes and draft text, but legislators still decide where to compromise and how to negotiate with the opposition.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 27,700 legislators employed in 2024, projected to reach 28,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 900 jobs, with roughly 2,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $44,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace legislators, but it will accelerate drafting and research. Legal research, draft generation, and public-opinion analysis speed up repetitive work, shifting legislators from writing toward judgment, negotiation, political responsibility, and cross-party mediation. Pure information organization and first drafts face pressure, while people with political judgment and accountability become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Automatic research of statutes and cases
Intelligent generation of legislative first drafts
ai_s3_list: Political judgment: people decide where to compromise.
Cross-party negotiation: people decide how to bargain.
Public responsibility: people decide how to vote.
Constituent communication: people explain whom to trust.
Crisis response: people judge the situation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation at moderate-high exposure in research work. Systems greatly accelerate research and drafting, while judgment and accountability remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not make legislators replaceable. AI replaces information organization and first-draft tasks, not political judgment. People who negotiate effectively and withstand public accountability become scarcer as productivity rises; speech-readers face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in law or public administration and join issue debates while studying. Pure research is shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment and negotiation early.
Advance from speechwriting to judgment plus coalition building. Learn AI research tools and pursue committee leadership.
Emphasize policy and negotiation experience, clearly identifying the issues you have handled. Teams value steadiness and reliability.
Do not hire on credentials alone. Look for people who research and write effectively; staff who can own major issues merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: AI handles drafting and research; people make decisions.
Limited seats create strong reelection pressure.
People with negotiation skills become more sought after.

body: Legislators review and enact laws in legislative bodies at different levels. They research public issues, draft and amend bills, hold hearings, vote, respond to constituents, and oversee implementation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can research statutes and draft text, but legislators still decide where to compromise and how to negotiate with the opposition.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你检索法条和写初稿，但哪条该让步、怎么和反对派谈，还是立法者定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年立法者在岗约 2.77 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.86 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代立法者，但会加速起草与研究。法条检索、草案生成和舆情分析把重复工作提速，立法者从「写稿」挪向「判断、协商、政治责任、跨方斡旋」。真正被挤掉的是纯资料整理与初稿，有政治脑子能扛责的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: 法条与案例的自动检索
ai_s3_list: 政治判断：让不让步靠人。
跨方协商：怎么谈靠人。
公共责任：票怎么投靠人。
选民沟通：信谁靠人讲。
危机处置：场面对不对靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的研究区——检索起草被系统大幅加速，但判断与责任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于可替代：被替代的是「资料整理与初稿」动作，不是「政治判断」的岗位。有协商力、能扛公众问责的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会念稿的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 法律或公管本科打底，在校多参加议题与辩论。AI 时代纯检索在缩，早点练判断和协商。
从「写稿」升级成「做判断 + 拉共识」，学 AI 研究工具，争取做委员会主官。
突出政策与协商经验，写清跟过哪些议题。团队看重稳和靠谱。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会研究能写。能扛议题的幕僚，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: AI 替起草研究，人做判断。
席位有限连任压力大。
有协商力的人更抢手。

body: 立法者（Legislators）在各级议会中审议和制定法律，调研公共议题、起草与修订议案、举行听证、投票表决，并回应选民诉求与监督执行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你检索法条和写初稿，但哪条该让步、怎么和反对派谈，还是立法者定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can contour structures automatically, but dosimetrists still verify whether an organ boundary receives excess dose.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 4,800 medical dosimetrists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 4,900 by 2034. That represents roughly 100 additional jobs and about 200 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $138,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace medical dosimetrists, but it will take over automated contouring and treatment-plan searches. Algorithms produce initial routine targets and dose distributions, shifting dosimetrists from running templates toward target judgment, plan review, and quality assurance. People limited to templates face the greatest pressure, while professionals who review and control plans remain more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Target judgment: people define boundaries.
Plan review: people assess quality.
Quality assurance: people safeguard safety.
Anomaly identification: people detect artifacts.
Accountability: clinical teams take responsibility for plans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure area. Contouring is substantially accelerated, while review and quality assurance still rely mainly on people, leaving the occupation stable overall.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Contouring is being accelerated, not the occupation itself. Dosimetrists who judge targets and review plans remain more resilient, while algorithms absorb template-only work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in medical physics and practice imaging and quality assurance during school. Template-only work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop review skills early.
Advance from running templates toward target judgment and quality assurance. Learn algorithms and work toward becoming a medical physicist.
Highlight treatment-planning and quality-assurance experience, and specify the machine models you have worked with. Relevant qualifications receive priority.
Do not hire based only on software proficiency; assess plan-review and quality-assurance skills. Professionals who provide effective safeguards deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated contouring becomes widespread, accelerating preparation.
Plan review and quality assurance become core capabilities.
Professionals who provide safeguards remain more resilient.

body: Medical dosimetrists use imaging and algorithms to design radiation-therapy dose plans, contour target volumes and organs at risk, optimize dose distributions, and perform plan quality assurance. They provide technical dose design and safety assurance in cancer radiotherapy.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can contour structures automatically, but dosimetrists still verify whether an organ boundary receives excess dose.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动勾画，但那器官边界到底压到没，还得剂量师核。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医学剂量师在岗约 0.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.49 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医学剂量师，但会接手自动勾画与计划搜索。算法把常规靶区与分布先跑出来，剂量师的时间从「跑模板」挪向「靶区判断、计划审核与质控把关」。真正被挤掉的是只跑模板的人，能审能控的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 靶区判断：边界靠人定。
计划审核：优劣靠人评。
质控把关：安全靠人守。
异常甄别：伪影靠人察。
责任归属：计划现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等偏上 AI 曝光区——勾画被明显加速，但审核与质控仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被加速的是「勾画」，不是「岗位」。会判靶区、能审计划的人更稳，只跑模板的人会被算法接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学物理打底，在校多练影像与质控。AI 时代纯跑模板在缩，早点练审核。
从「跑模板」升级成「判靶区 + 质控」，学算法，争取往物理师走。
突出计划与质控经历，写清跟过哪些机型。有资质优先。
招人别只看会软件，要看审核和质控。能把关的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动勾画普及，准备提速。
计划审核与质制成核心能力。
能把关的人更稳。

body: 医学剂量师运用影像与算法设计放射治疗剂量计划，勾画靶区与危险器官，优化照射分布并执行业计划质控，是肿瘤放疗中剂量设计与安全保障的技术角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动勾画，但那器官边界到底压到没，还得剂量师核。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce models and portfolios, but advisors still decide which clients merit long-term development, how to turn a proposal into an enduring commitment, and how to discuss risk.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 326,000 personal financial advisors were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 357,200, a net increase of about 31,200 jobs, with about 24,100 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $102,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace personal financial advisors, but it will reduce standard roles. Robo-advisors accelerate routine allocation, shifting advisors from selling products toward trust building, complex planning, and behavioral coaching. Advisors who only sell standard portfolios face displacement, while those who develop relationships and customize solutions become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Trust building: people nurture relationships.
Complex planning: people understand families.
Behavioral coaching: people provide stability during volatility.
Solution customization: people uncover the pain points.
Long-term commitment: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates moderately high exposure in finance. Systems accelerate standard allocation, but people remain essential for relationship development and customization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Selling standard portfolios is being replaced, not trust-building roles. People who develop client relationships and customize plans become scarcer as productivity improves. Advisors limited to standard products are vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Finance professionals should develop planning skills and credentials. Pure volume selling is shrinking in the AI era, so build relationship-management skills early.
Advance from selling products to developing plans + nurturing clients, and learn asset allocation.
Highlight your client base and cases and specify the families you have advised.
Do not assess candidates by speaking ability alone. Determine whether they understand relationship management.

ai_s7_trends: Robo-advisors become widespread
Fewer standardized roles
Advisors with strong relationship-development skills are in greater demand

body: Personal financial advisors lead financial planning and asset allocation for individuals, coordinating goals, risks, and products and using financial expertise and communication to turn income into actionable wealth plans.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce models and portfolios, but advisors still decide which clients merit long-term development, how to turn a proposal into an enduring commitment, and how to discuss risk.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能出模型与组合，但哪类客户值得养、怎么讲成长期托付、风险怎么聊，还是顾问定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年个人理财顾问在岗约 32.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.72 万人，净增约 3.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代个人理财顾问，但会压缩标准岗。智能投顾把常规配置提速，顾问从「卖产品」挪向「信任经营、复杂规划、行为陪伴」。真正被挤掉的是只卖标准组合的，有经营力能定制的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 信任经营：关系靠人养。
复杂规划：家庭靠人懂。
行为陪伴：波动靠人稳。
方案定制：痛点靠人挖。
长期托付：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的金融区——标准配置被系统加速，但经营与定制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「卖标准组合」动作，不是「信任经营」的岗位。有经营力、能定制方案的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只卖标准产品的顾问。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融多练规划与持证，AI 时代纯卖量在缩，早点练经营。
从「卖产品」升级成「做方案 + 养客户」，学配置。
突出客源与案例，写清跟过哪些家庭。
选人别只看口才，要看有没有经营脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 智能投顾普及
标准岗缩
有经营力的顾问更抢手

body: 个人理财顾问主导个人理财规划与资产配置，统筹目标、风险与产品，运用财务知识与沟通手段，把收入落成可执行的财富方案。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能出模型与组合，但哪类客户值得养、怎么讲成长期托付、风险怎么聊，还是顾问定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machine vision can align components automatically, but when a batch of parameters drifts, technicians still determine whether the lens or the algorithm is responsible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 67,300 photonics technicians were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 68,300, a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with about 5,700 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $77,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace photonics technicians as a whole, but it will sharply reduce standard assembly and alignment roles. Automated alignment, machine vision, and test automation take over repetitive alignment, shifting human time toward process tuning, exception handling, and precision assembly. Operators who only move lenses without learning processes face displacement, while people who understand principles and tune equipment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Process tuning: people explore narrow windows.
Exception handling: people identify causes of parameter drift.
Precision assembly and alignment: people handle high-end components.
Equipment maintenance: people rescue unexpected failures.
Integrated judgment: connect assembly and testing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 indicates moderately high exposure in assembly and alignment. Vision systems replace substantial standardized alignment, while people retain process expertise and precision work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard assembly and alignment face replacement, not the occupation itself. People who tune processes, understand principles, and handle anomalies become scarcer as automation spreads. Technicians who only move lenses without learning processes face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in optoelectronics or electromechanics and spend substantial time in laboratories while studying. Standard roles are shrinking in the AI era, so learn processes and principles early.
Advance from moving lenses to tuning processes + managing anomalies. Learn high-end optical modules and lasers, and pursue process-engineer roles.
Highlight assembly, alignment, and yield experience, clearly stating which devices you have handled. Cleanroom experience is preferred.
When hiring, assess process thinking, not steady hands alone. Technicians who troubleshoot anomalies and protect yield deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated alignment and machine vision continue absorbing standard roles.
Optical communications and laser demand drive high-end process work.
Technicians who understand both processes and principles are in greater demand.

body: Photonics technicians assemble, align, test, and maintain optical components and systems at optoelectronic-device and laser manufacturers. They operate lasers, fibers, and test equipment and use parameter standards to protect optical-module performance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Machine vision can align components automatically, but when a batch of parameters drifts, technicians still determine whether the lens or the algorithm is responsible.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器视觉能自动对准，但一批参数飘了、到底是镜片还是算法的问题，还得技术员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年光子学技术员在岗约 6.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.83 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会整体取代光子学技术员，但会大幅压缩标准装调岗。自动对准、机器视觉和测试自动化把重复对准接走了，人的时间转向工艺调试、异常处置和精密装调。真正被挤掉的是只会搬镜片、不学工艺的操作工，懂原理又会调设备的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 异常检测模型辅助排查
数字孪生辅助工艺验证
ai_s3_list: 工艺调试：窗口窄靠人摸。
异常处置：飘参要人定因。
精密装调：高端件靠手。
设备维护：突发要人救。
综合判断：把装测串起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的装调区——大量标准化对准能被视觉和系统替代，但工艺与精密还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准装调」，不是「岗位」。会做工艺调试、懂原理、能处置异常的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会搬镜片、不学工艺的技术员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 光电/机电专业打底，在校多进实验室。AI 时代标准岗在缩，早点练工艺和原理。
从「搬镜片」升级成「调工艺 + 管异常」，学高端光模块和激光，争取转工艺工程师。
突出装调和良率经验，写清做过哪些器件。有洁净室经验优先。
招人别只看手稳，看工艺脑子。能调异常、保良率的技术员值得更高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 自动对准与机器视觉继续吃标准岗。
光通信与激光需求拉动高端工艺。
懂工艺懂原理的技术员更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Turnstiles can validate tickets automatically, but on-site staff still decide which way people should go, how to find a lost child, and how to prevent crowding after an event.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 121,700 ushers, lobby attendants, and ticket takers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 123,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,400 jobs, with approximately 30,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $31,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will reduce routine tasks. Electronic tickets and turnstiles accelerate standard ticket checking, shifting workers from tearing tickets to guiding guests, calming concerns, handling incidents, and maintaining the visitor experience. Window ticketing-only roles will be squeezed out, while people who can manage crowds and adapt will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site guidance: people direct traffic flows.
Emergency crowd management: people calm disorder.
Guest reassurance: people respond to emotions.
Special assistance: people care for older adults, children, and vulnerable guests.
Experience maintenance: people provide dignity and consideration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate ticket checking, but people still handle guidance and unexpected situations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Window ticket validation tasks are being replaced, not on-site service roles. People who can manage crowds and adapt become even scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build communication and adaptability skills. Pure window ticketing is shrinking, so develop on-site service and crowd management abilities early.
Advance from tearing tickets to maintaining the experience and handling incidents, then seek team leadership or operations roles.
Highlight patience and examples of adapting to difficult service situations. Venues value stability and approachability.
Do not select people based only on physical stamina. Assess whether they can manage crowds and reassure guests. Employees who can lead a venue team are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: As electronic tickets become widespread, ticket windows are shrinking.
On-site service receives greater emphasis.
People with crowd management skills are in greater demand.

body: Ushers, lobby attendants, and ticket takers check tickets, guide guests to seats, maintain order, and provide audience service at performances, sporting events, and venues, ensuring smooth entry and exit.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 闸机能自动验票，但哪边该走、孩子走丢怎么找、散场怎么不挤，还是现场的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年引座员、大堂服务员、票务在岗约 12.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 12.31 万人，净增约 0.14 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩标准环节。电子票与闸机把常规检票提速，人从「撕票」挪向「引导、安抚、突发处理、体验维护」。真正被挤掉的是只做窗口票务的，会疏导、能应变的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场引导：动线靠人指。
突发疏导：慌乱靠人稳。
观众安抚：情绪靠人接。
特殊照护：老弱靠人看。
体验维护：体面靠人给。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——检票被系统加速，但引导与应变还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「窗口验票」动作，不是「现场服务」的岗位。会疏导、能应变的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 多练沟通和应变，纯窗口票务在缩，早点练现场服务与疏导。
从「撕票」升级成「体验维护 + 突发处理」，争取带班或运营。
突出服务耐心和应变案例，场馆看重稳和亲和。
选人别只看体力，要看会不会疏导和安抚，能带场的值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 电子票普及，窗口缩。
现场服务更被看重。
会疏导的人更抢手。
